exposure: third trimester screening of fetal growth restriction
outcome: Knowledge and practices surrounding third trimester screening of fetal growth restriction (FGR) in low risk pregnancies
Consideration of third trimester ultrasound for FGR screening
Accuracy of symphysis-fundus distance for FGR screening
Impact of third trimester ultrasound on cesarean delivery rate
Impact of routine ultrasound on admission rate to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 298 Gynecologists/Obstetricians and 275 General Practitioners in Portugal
finding: There was variation in opinions between Gynecologists/Obstetricians and General Practitioners regarding the best screening practices for FGR in low-risk pregnancies, reflecting the ongoing controversy in this area.
mod_finding: 50% of GOs believe third trimester ultrasound would not impact cesarean delivery rates for fetal distress, while 41% of GPs believe it would increase the rate.
